title_zh: 决定继续试用简短版画廊语音导览

scenario.label_zh: 决定继续试用简短版画廊语音导览
scenario.goal_zh: 比较语音导览与安静观赏的体验后，决定继续试用简短版并保留关闭选项

context_zh: 画廊志愿者向试听语音导览的访客收集反馈。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Did the audio enhance your visit, or did it get in the way of looking at the paintings?

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: The short comments made it more enjoyable. The long biography was too much for me.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: The artist's enthusiasm really comes through in that recording. I was reluctant to cut it.

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: I can hear why. I am enthusiastic about hearing artists explain their work, just not for ten minutes beside one picture.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: So perhaps we should keep the short introduction and make the full interview optional.

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: Yes, and leave an easy way to turn the sound off.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: We will keep testing that shorter version this week.

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: I would be happy to try it again after the change.
